thread:
mike: heads-up from today's multi-region dry-run: observed ~180ms period where writes were accepted in both us-west and eu-central during a tenant move. filing notes here.

mike: sequence was: operator issues DRAIN -> proxies ACK immediate -> operator finalizes lease -> traffic flips. overlap happens because ACK != fully drained.

anya: ack semantics mismatch. proxies must report progress, not just receipt.

rebecca: propose small FSM: SENT -> ACKED -> DRAINING -> QUIESCED -> COMMIT. operator waits for QUIESCED.

dave: streaming clients complicate QUIESCED; long websockets keep inflight>0 indefinitely. suggestion: stop new stream attach and emit reconnect hint; escrow non-idempotent writes.

mike: escrow design: per-tenant ephemeral queue in control plane, TTL default 25s, response 202+Location for client. worker applies to target once QUIESCED signal received.

anya: must enforce residency: tenants tagged EU_ONLY cannot have their escrow or forwards touch non-EU storage. preflight check blocks swap with E_RESIDENCY_VIOLATION.

rebecca: telemetry + gating: escrow.depth and proxy.inflight_count. operator aborts if escrow depth>threshold or retries>3. ops-bot, add alert rule.

ops-bot: noted. created alert: `swap.escrow.depth_high || swap.retries >= 3 -> page oncall-eng`. :bell: 

dave: proxies need /drain_status returning state, inflight_count, streams_active. responses signed and idempotent. also add header X-RW-Drain-State in proxied responses.

mike: i'll draft RFC with FSM diagram, sample proxy responses, CLI prototype for operator swap: `redwoodctl swap --tenant tn-77 --from us --to eu --grace 30s`. aim to open PR by Friday for legal review.

anya: +1. include examples for websocket soft-cutover and sample error code E_RESIDENCY_VIOLATION.

rebecca: also document rollback behavior: if escrow spikes or QUIESCED never arrives, operator should revert commit and resume source-serving. add audit events for each step.

mike: agreed. ping me with more corner cases. :thumbsup:
